status.cycle_paused.description: Banner on the status overview while the operator has paused a running cycle. The page decides it is paused from the reported state, never by matching this sentence.

status.cycle_resuming.description: Label on the resume control after the operator activates it and before the runner confirms. Kept short: it replaces the control's own label in place.

status.cycle_resume_action.description: Label on the control that resumes a paused cycle.

status.host_online_count.description: Summary above the host table. Counts hosts the pool currently reaches.

status.step_timing_unavailable.message: No per-step timing was recorded for this cycle.
status.step_timing_unavailable.description: Shown in place of the timing breakdown when a cycle finished without step-level timings, so an empty panel does not read as a load failure.

status.cycle_duration.description: Total wall-clock time of the cycle, shown under the timing breakdown.

status.external_detail.description: Frames text produced by a program outside Yuruna. The detail is shown as given and is never read back as state.

status.directory_index_title.description: Title and heading on a generated status-service directory listing.

status.directory_contents_caption.description: Accessible caption on a generated status-service directory listing.

status.directory_column_name.description: Name column heading on a generated directory listing.

status.directory_column_size.description: File-size column heading on a generated directory listing.

status.directory_column_modified_utc.description: Last-modified column heading on a generated directory listing.

status.directory_parent.description: Accessible expansion of the ../ link on a generated directory listing.

status.file_size_bytes.description: A directory-listing file size below one kibibyte.

status.file_size_kilobytes.description: A directory-listing file size expressed in kibibytes.

status.file_size_megabytes.description: A directory-listing file size expressed in mebibytes.

status.file_size_gigabytes.description: A directory-listing file size expressed in gibibytes.

status.error_file_too_large.description: Plain-text status-service response when a requested file exceeds the serving bound.

status.error_not_found.description: Plain-text status-service response when a requested path does not exist.
